text: まずは　つかまえる　ポケモンの　たいりょくを　へらすんだ

structure.jp: つかまえる　ポケモンの　たいりょくを
structure.en: the HP of the Pokémon you're catching

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: つかまえる　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. つかまえる　ポケモン = 'the Pokémon you are going to catch'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ; after a plain verb it can tell someone what to do, like a coach explaining. へらすんだ = 'what you do is reduce it'.
